title: Define provider TTS streaming audio queue and playback artifact boundaries
description: AstrBot TTS providers expose support_stream and get_audio_stream with text/audio queues, while some providers return bytes and others write files. Rust has TTS providers and media artifact tasks, but not a streaming audio queue/playback boundary for live feedback.

files.change: Define typed text input/audio output stream contracts separately from file-based TTS synthesis.
Represent text-correlated audio chunks, terminal markers, and stream errors without binding to one provider protocol.
Allow live-agent feedback to consume TTS audio streams through a provider-neutral port.

criteria: File-based and streaming TTS providers remain independently testable.
Audio chunks can carry optional source text and a terminal signal.
Live feedback code depends on provider-neutral TTS stream ports, not concrete adapters.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-provider && cargo test -p astrbot-agent && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
